title: Configuration count bound
statement: Let $K,B,P,T$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $K+1$ work tapes and a finite state set $S$. Suppose every transition either leaves the last work tape's scanned cell unchanged or writes the symbol $1$ there. If the run of $M$ from its initial configuration on $x$ is halted by time $T$, and at every time $t\le T$ the first $K$ work-tape heads have absolute positions at most $B$ while the last work-tape head has absolute position at most $P$, then the configuration at time $(|S|+1)(|x|+2)3^{K(2B+1)}(2B+1)^K(2P+1)(2P+2)$ equals the configuration at time $T$.
hypotheses_covered: The machine has $K+1$ work tapes and Boolean symbols

The run from the initial configuration is halted at time $T$

For every $t\le T$, the last head position has absolute value at most $P$
